title: Utillian 2 Wax Pen Concentrate Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The Utillian 2 wax pen concentrate vape device features 4 voltage settings, a dual quartz coil, a 650mAh battery, glass mouthpiece and convenient magnetic attachments for easy loading.
You should get the Utillian 2 if you are looking for a super convenient wax pen that is simple to use and can easily get the job done. The Utillian 2 wax pen offers a hassle-free wax experience, featuring magnetic attachments for easy loading and 4 voltage settings to control your vapor.
Never deal with sticky, gummed up threading again! The Utillian 2 wax pen features magnetic attachments for the battery, atomizer and mouthpiece which helps make loading quick & effortless.
The Utillian 2 offers users 4 voltage settings: 3.0V, 3.4V, 3.8V, 4.2V giving you a lot of versatility for enjoying your wax and concentrates.
A glass mouthpiece rounds out the Utillian 2 wax pen kit, helping preserve the flavor of your extracts.
